messages:
Rae (Finance): AP put AtlasCompute invoice AC-2026-782 on hold. Bot says PO mismatch + vendor ID mismatch. Can AP share details? :eyes:

Diego (AP): ap-bot: HOLD_REASON=PO_MISMATCH; invoice references PO 5902 but our vendor master links AtlasCompute to PO 5901. Also tax calc doesn't match our tax profile. Need corrected PO reference or vendor master update + supporting tax doc.

Maya (Vendor Ops): Vendor says they auto-assigned PO 5902 after internal consolidation. They uploaded invoice PDF but used vendor ID AC-INT instead of AtlasComputeInc. I asked them to confirm legal entity and attach W-9 equivalent.

Rae (Finance): We need: (1) invoice reissued with PO 5901 or a signed amendment transferring invoice to PO 5902 with Procurement approval, (2) vendor legal name matching vendor master or vendor master update, (3) tax certificate if tax differs.

ap-bot: Invoice AC-2026-782 uploaded by Maya; status=HOLD (PO_VENDOR_MISMATCH). Ticket AP-8124.

Omar (Procurement): If vendor wants to use PO 5902, vendor must provide a short note: "AtlasComputeInc agrees to consolidate invoices under entity AC-INT; procurement approval attached." Then Procurement will update PO linkage. No retroactive acceptance without signed doc.

Maya (Vendor Ops): Told vendor to either (A) reissue invoice referencing PO 5901 with AtlasComputeInc as vendor name or (B) submit signed consolidation note + tax cert to move to PO 5902. Asked them to pause collections while we sort.

Diego (AP): Once they reissue or provide docs we'll validate tax math and route for payment. If they provide consolidation note we'll need Procurement + Finance sign-off before AP will pay.

AtlasCompute Billing (via Maya): "Uploading corrected invoice AC-2026-782v2 referencing PO 5901 and legal name AtlasComputeInc. Attached: corrected PDF and company registration doc."

ap-bot: New invoice AC-2026-782v2 uploaded; matched to PO 5901 by Maya; awaiting AP validation.

Diego (AP): Verified PO match and tax calc now correct. Routing for payment. Closing hold. :white_check_mark:

Rae (Finance): Thanks. Maya, please add note to vendor master: require vendor-entity confirmation before PO consolidation. Marking AP-8124 resolved.

Maya (Vendor Ops): Done. Noted requirement and updated vendor record.
